t: You're at the site of the Beaufoy Vinegar Factory in South Lambeth. The factory has been demolished, so what you're looking at now is the place where it used to stand. It was founded by John Hanbury Beaufoy, a vinegar company owner who lived from 1761 to 1836, and the factory carries his name. Beaufoy matters here twice over: he started the business, and his surname is the one attached to this spot. I don't have more detail about the buildings or the work done here, so I won't add to that.
